description: Welcome to Team  Blaze. We are tackling the "Field Shift" challengeto build a scalable tool that turns NASA Earth observation data into actionable insights. Join us to help farmers adapt to climate change and impact global food security.
summary: Blaze Field Advisor is a Hindi-first web app that helps smallholder farmers in Agra district, Uttar Pradesh, explore crop-rotation options using real NASA climate data. It fetches NASA POWER climatology (temperature and rainfall, 2001–2025) live in the browser and shows annual temperature, June–September monsoon rainfall and heat-stress months. It then compares four rotations: the current Paddy–Wheat practice against Maize–Wheat + Moong, Bajra–Mustard + cover crop, and Paddy–Wheat + Dhaincha green manure. Farmers choose priorities (save water, improve soil, extra income) and the ranking updates with visible weights. A Hindi voice readout and transcript make the advice accessible to low-literacy users. Every number is badged "Live · NASA POWER" or "Sample", scoring is transparent rule-based logic (not machine learning), and each option lists evidence, gaps and risks that need a local agronomist's review. It turns Earth observation data into simple, honest decision support as rainfall patterns shift and water for rice–wheat farming becomes scarcer.
details:
What it does: A farmer picks a district (Agra by default), sees live NASA POWER climate normals (annual temperature, JUN–SEP rainfall, heat-stress months) in a chart, selects priorities, and gets four crop-rotation options ranked with transparent scores for water use, soil health, climate fit and an illustrative income index. Each option shows why it is suggested, evidence, information gaps and risks, plus a Hindi voice readout with a visible transcript.

Honesty by design: every figure is badged Live · NASA POWER or Sample. If NASA is unreachable, the app falls back to a captured NASA POWER response and badges everything Sample. Scoring is rule-based, not ML; crop water and soil tables are curated approximations flagged "agronomist review needed". The income index is illustrative.

Tech: HTML/CSS/JavaScript (no framework), SVG chart, Canvas 2D hero driven by the fetched rainfall and temperature values, Web Speech API (hi-IN), Node test runner, GitHub Actions CI, Vercel hosting with security headers and CSP. Mobile-first, works at 360 px, no cookies, no analytics, no accounts.

Impact and limits: designed as decision support that advises, never commands. Next steps: GPM IMERG, SMAP soil moisture, MODIS NDVI, GRACE groundwater, agronomist-reviewed tables, more districts, a caching proxy.
